title: Fundsmith Equity Fund Update Webinar - July 2026
description: Terry Smith shares the latest on Fundsmith Equity Fund — covering performance, portfolio activity and the modifications to the ‘Do Nothing’ leg of the investment process as set out in the Semi-Annual Letter to Shareholders.
summary: The Fundsmith Equity Fund update identifies Fortinet, Texas Instruments, and Alphabet as top performers, noting that positions taken after specific market dislocations or capacity announcements have paid off. Conversely, the speaker expresses caution on LVMH due to a lack of recovery in China and maintains a mixed view on Microsoft regarding its AI spending and gaming segment. The portfolio manager also explains a deliberate strategy of avoiding major semiconductor and tech giants like Nvidia, Broadcom, and Apple to prevent negating index exposure.
